title: [review] appendix-schc.md: Match-mapping index overflow unspecified
description: The match-mapping uses a 3-bit index (max 8 values) but the type list '[0,3,2,5,6,7,...]' implies more entries. Behavior when encountering a type beyond index 7 is unspecified - should it fall back to value-sent or fail?
close_reason: Fixed: Corrected PIO type from 3 to 8 per RFC 6550, replaced unbounded mapping list [0,3,2,5,6,7,...] with exact [0,8,2,5,6,7], and added fallback behavior note (unrecognized types cause rule mismatch and fall back to rule 255). Updated both appendix-schc.md and draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md for consistency.
